name: m01_harbour
prompt: Strict first-person POV at eye height, looking straight ahead down the middle of a wide modern concrete harbour promenade at night in heavy rain, one-point perspective. On the left, modern glass-and-concrete apartment towers with hundreds of lit windows, some with the cool glow of screens; on the right, the black harbour water, and across it a dense modern skyline of glass towers and a sleek modern bridge with LED lights, all reflected in the water. The promenade ahead is flooded with a shallow sheet of rippling water reflecting white and amber lights. Anonymous, contemporary, lonely, empty at 1 a.m. No body, no hands, no people, no text. Realistic, cinematic 35mm, film grain.
